campaign.title: Global lower-radial profile-height and character-pairing gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use no new theorem unless a primary source matches the exact reciprocal phase, mod-four character, moving height, one-sided hard profile, floor perturbation, and pointwise real-X norm. Existing transform identities are barriers unless they produce a quantified inequality.

frozen_target.question: After summing every exact dyadic denominator profile into one floor-perturbed height kernel before applying a norm, does mod-four denominator pairing yield a target-safe joint height inequality for the complete lower-radial antecedent, or what is the smallest exact survivor?
frozen_target.reference_formula: B_low^+=sum_j sum_(h<=H_j) Phi(h/(H_j+1))/h sum_d chi_4(d)w_j(d)V_low(4R^2h^2/d^2)e(hX/d)=sum_(h,d)chi_4(d)A_X(h,d)V_low(4R^2h^2/d^2)e(hX/d)/h, target B_low^+<<R X^epsilon, R=X^(1/4).
quantities: X large real, R=X^(1/4), Y=sqrt X, y=floor(sqrt X)
D_j=2^(-j)y and H_j=floor(D_j/R), with empty heights omitted
exact hard top and smooth profiles w_j, inactive bottom kept separate
fixed physical V_low from the proved radial one-count partition
mod-four pair F_X(4m+1)-F_X(4m+3) with zero-extended boundaries
amplitude seam and joint phase increment Delta_d=2X/(d(d+2))
all floors, profile stars, stationary stars, hard sample, product half tie, and both signs
accepted one-sided-divisor, Appell, product-wavelet, crossing, and conductor barriers
full lower range, including the part above the small-angle replacement threshold

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact lower reciprocal antecedent and external R normalization.
Prove the finite profile-first aggregation with every floor and boundary owner retained.
Derive the mod-four denominator-pair identity with zero-extension and no lost endpoint.
Bound or exactly isolate the amplitude-variation seam, including hard and bottom jumps.
Keep the phase-increment height sum signed until a quantified inequality is obtained.
Audit resonant and nonresonant denominator pairs at the full R X^epsilon budget.
Distinguish any new kernel from the accepted one-sided Poisson, Appell, product-wavelet, and crossing returns.
Prove the complete lower target, a strict target-safe subpackage, a signed power saving, or a rigorous no-go with the smallest survivor.
State exactly what follows for GAR, blockwise M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint uniformity, M9, and every exponent.

tasks.target: Independently rederive the complete lower reciprocal antecedent, its exact profile-first and mod-four-paired kernels, and prove a bound, strict subpackage, or smallest survivor without using nonblind history.
excluded_context: all Round-61 through Round-121 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact one-count and paired-kernel derivation.
A complete bound, strict target-safe package, signed saving, or smallest exact survivor.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Formalize the exact full-profile height kernel, prove the amplitude seam, and attack the jointly signed mod-four phase-increment kernel by a capacity-explicit resonant/nonresonant or height-first inequality.
required_output: An exact amplitude/phase seam identity and capacity table.
A complete estimate, strict target-safe region, power saving, or exact return/no-go.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the exact pairing, boundary and floor ledger, resonance capacity, false analogues, comparison with prior return maps, and every claimed implication of the global lower height-kernel route.
required_output: A pass/fail seam table and adversarial capacity controls.
The maximal safe theorem or the fatal correction and smallest survivor.

review_seams.requirement: The positive reciprocal antecedent, lower radial multiplier, transform normalization, and conjugate frequency are exact.
Every active profile, height floor, hard sample, and physical boundary occurs exactly once; the inactive bottom remains separate.
The mod-four pair is an exact zero-extended identity, including the top and bottom leftover pairs.
Any BV estimate includes profile crossings, height cutoffs, the lower multiplier, and hard jumps.
The height sum remains signed through the phase-increment step; no termwise absolute-value gain is credited.
All discrete resonances of the reciprocal phase are priced, including the threshold interface.
An Appell, Poisson, wavelet, crossing, or conductor reformulation is not called a saving unless a new quantitative inequality is proved.
A subcritical block result does not close the full lower cutoff, and GAR is not confused with blockwise M9-M1 or the final M9 conjunction.
